race.comment: GEEGEES DOWNPOUR (3) sat back and unleashed a quick burst to score comfortably by a length fresh up here 3 weeks ago, his first time wearing blinkers. He stays in the same class, and with only an extra 1.5kg to carry, he can win again. BRAVE JET (11) hit the line late in a tougher field here a fortnight ago, and even from a wide gate, he can bounce straight back into the money with the drop down to a more suitable grade. DENNYSON (1) worked far too hard from a wide gate here last start, and understandably weakened in the run home. He has won trials on either side of that effort, and can make amends. Each way. PLATINUM REGGAE (12) strips fitter second up, and is good enough to run into the top 4 here at odds.
